definition: FlowerChecker, also known as Kindwise, is a company that uses machine learning to identify natural objects from images.
details: This includes plants and their diseases, but also insects and mushrooms. It is based in Brno, Czech Republic. It was founded in 2014 by Ondřej Veselý, Jiří Řihák, and Ondřej Vild, at the time Ph.D. students.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. What your eyes do without thinking, the machine does one careful layer at a time. The machine learns to see the way we do — starting with shapes and edges, then building up to whole objects and faces. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Kindwise — giving a machine the gift of sight.
